Once the restructuring is fully implemented, ZoomInfo anticipates an annual reduction in run-rate operating expenses of approximately $60 million\. The company maintains impressive gross profit margins of 87% and generates strong free cash flow, positioning it well to benefit from the operational improvements\. The company noted that the estimates and timing of the charges are subject to assumptions and may vary depending on local legal requirements and other factors\.
